memory_before.meridian-credits-release-1-0: Meridian Credits release 1.0 agreement (applies to all explicit "release":"1.0" requests and is current when release is omitted). Source: Finance-approved specification in issue trial-56h, 2026-09-07. A line has exactly nonempty string line_id/account_id/subscription_id, valid 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31 Gregorian service_on, and nonnegative integer charge_cents; line_id is request-unique. Subscription cap groups are (account_id, subscription_id), not subscription_id alone. Compute each uncapped line credit as floor(charge_cents * 10 / 100), then allocate a shared 2400-cent group cap by earliest service_on then increasing Unicode-code-point line_id; assigned line credit is min(uncapped credit, remaining cap). No service date excludes a line. Total credit is the sum of assigned credits and total due is charges minus credit. A one-line quote treats its supplied line as the complete statement: request {"command":"quote","line":LINE}, optionally explicit release 1.0; response has exactly release "1.0", copied line_id, credit_cents, and amount_due_cents.

Group all lines with the same account_id, including lines from distinct subscriptions. Calculate each uncapped line credit independently as floor(charge_cents * 15 / 100). Allocate a shared 3000-cent account cap by descending charge_cents, then increasing Unicode-code-point line_id on ties. Each assigned credit is min(uncapped credit, remaining group cap). No service date excludes a line. Total credit is assigned-credit sum; total due is charges minus total credit. A one-line quote treats its supplied line as its complete statement.   within a request. A subscription is identified by the pair (account_id,     
  subscription_id); the same subscription_id can occur under different        
  accounts, and a subscription can have several charge lines. service_on is a 
  valid Gregorian YYYY-MM-DD date from 2020-01-01 through 2099-12-31.         
  charge_cents is a nonnegative integer in US cents. No line is excluded by   
  its service date. Each request is the complete charge set of one            
  independently quoted monthly statement; caps apply within that set. Line    
  collections may be empty. Lexicographic ID order means Unicode code-point   
  order. JSON object key order is immaterial; do not add response keys beyond

  initial quote issue. Current statement behavior remains release 2.0, and    
  existing quote and total versions remain supported.                         
                                                                              
  For empty lines, return                                                     
  {"release":"1.0","lines":[],"credit_cents":0,"amount_due_cents":0}. A one-  
  line receipt for the original quote example returns {"release": "1.0",      
  "credit_cents": 1999, "amount_due_cents": 18000, "lines": [{"line_id": "L-
